comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record reattaches the robot's detached wrist camera to its own mount.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve inserting hardware into a retaining interface, but candidate requires long-part bimanual leveling, paired spring-prong latching at two posts, extension, and screw fastening; record uses a sliding shoe/channel and retaining tooth.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four engagements, rack-unit consistency, screws, self-support, and 3 s hold; record requires camera optical pose within 5 mm/5°, sensor-pose consistency, live imagery, right-arm clearance, and 2 s hold.
comparison.reason: The camera task tests self-repair plus sensor reinstatement at one sliding mount; the candidate tests staged structural rack attachment across separated supports. Candidate's exact engagement and optical-independent pose tolerances are missing.
